tasks.title: Add GET /:number/commits API endpoint
tasks.description: Add `GET /api/issues/:number/commits` route in `packages/cli/src/api/issues.ts`. Use `git log <baseBranch>..mo/issue-<N> --format='%h%x00%s%x00%an%x00%aI' --stat` with NUL-delimited parsing. Follow the same validation pattern as the existing `/:number/diff` route (project check, issue lookup, worktree existence). Return `{ commits: [{ hash, message, author, date, filesChanged, additions, deletions }] }` ordered newest-first.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/issues/:number/commits returns commits array with hash, message, author, date, filesChanged, additions, deletions when worktree exists with commits
Returns { commits: [] } when no worktree or no commits
tasks.notes: Follow the exact pattern of the existing GET /:number/diff handler (issues.ts:1152-1226). Use execFileAsync for git commands. Place the new route after the /:number/diff handler.

tasks.title: Add GET /:number/commits/:hash/diff API endpoint
tasks.description: Add `GET /api/issues/:number/commits/:hash/diff` route in `packages/cli/src/api/issues.ts`. Use `git branch --contains <hash> --list mo/issue-<N>` to verify hash belongs to the issue branch, then `git show <hash> --format='' --patch` for the diff. Return `{ hash, diff }` with raw unified diff text.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/issues/:number/commits/:hash/diff returns { hash, diff } when hash belongs to issue branch
Returns 404 when commit does not belong to issue branch
tasks.notes: Place after the GET /:number/commits handler. Hash validation uses `git branch --contains` check — if output is empty, hash does not belong to the branch.

tasks.title: Add frontend types, API client methods, and React Query hooks
tasks.description: Add `CommitEntry` type (hash, message, author, date, filesChanged, additions, deletions) and `CommitDiff` type (hash, diff) to `packages/cli/web/src/lib/types.ts`. Add `getIssueCommits(number)` and `getCommitDiff(number, hash)` methods to `packages/cli/web/src/lib/api.ts`. Add `useIssueCommits(number)` and `useCommitDiff(number, hash, enabled)` hooks to `packages/cli/web/src/hooks/useQueries.ts`.
acceptanceCriteria: CommitEntry type has all 7 fields (hash, message, author, date, filesChanged, additions, deletions)
useCommitDiff hook accepts enabled flag for lazy loading
tasks.notes: Follow existing patterns: DiffFile type at types.ts:88-92, api.getIssueDiff at api.ts:56-57, useIssueDiff at useQueries.ts:43-49.

tasks.title: Implement Changed Files tab layout and Commits view
tasks.description: Modify `IssueDetailPage.tsx` Changed Files area (lines 295-310) to support Files/Commits tab switching with a `diffTab` state ('files' | 'commits'). Files tab shows existing file list unchanged. Commits tab shows commit list using `useIssueCommits` hook — each row with short hash (mono), message, relative time, +/- stats. Clicking a row toggles expanded diff loaded via `useCommitDiff` (lazy). Diff rendered line-by-line with green/red/gray CSS. Show 'No commits yet' empty state. Commits tab title shows count: 'Commits (N)'.
acceptanceCriteria: Changed Files area shows Files and Commits (N) tabs with Files as default
Clicking Commits tab shows commit list with hash, message, time, +/- stats
Clicking a commit row expands its diff below (green for +, red for -, mono font)
Multiple commits can be expanded simultaneously
Loading indicator shown while diff fetches
'Failed to load diff' shown on error
'No commits yet' shown when commits array is empty
Tab selection persists across data refreshes (SSE events)
Area hidden when both files and commits are empty
tasks.notes: Use `useState<'files' | 'commits'>('files')` for tab state and `Set<string>` for tracking expanded commit hashes. Use relative time formatting from existing `formatTime` utility. Keep all existing Files view code intact — only wrap with tab header and conditionally render.
